recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If the Immunization Incubator IG continues to maintain ImmunizationEvaluation, a separate external-repository follow-up should correct "doese" to "dose" and optionally align punctuation with the original FHIR-28151 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-28151 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to clean ImmunizationEvaluation publisher warnings by taking no action on the informational RIM-mapping warning, changing doseStatusReason.short to "Reason why the dose is considered valid, invalid, or some other status", and changing targetDisease.short to "The vaccine preventable disease schedule being evaluated".
initial_application: Core commit f39499ca0d3db1420b7dbe4c688151d38b8744ac applied the issue to source/immunizationevaluation/structuredefinition-ImmunizationEvaluation.xml, setting targetDisease.short to the requested text and changing doseStatusReason.short to the intended text, though with the typo "doese" and without the comma from the Jira wording. PHWG 2022-02-18 meeting notes also record FHIR-28151 as "Persuasive with Mod - applied".
additional_context: Current core no longer builds ImmunizationEvaluation. Commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed source/immunizationevaluation and active fhir.ini entries for the resource, while current core pages link ImmunizationEvaluation to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/immunization-incubator/en/StructureDefinition-ImmunizationEvaluation.html. That external continuous build still shows the requested targetDisease short text and the migrated doseStatusReason typo.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty external-repo audit commit because there is no in-build ImmunizationEvaluation StructureDefinition in the current HL7/fhir checkout to correct.
